syntheticDatasets.title: Synthetic datasets
syntheticDatasets.intro: A synthetic dataset fills a non-production environment with generated data shaped like the profiled tables it names, at a chosen scale. In that environment its tables read the generated data in place of their sources.
syntheticDatasets.noEnvironment: Create a non-production environment to hold a synthetic dataset; production cannot hold one.
syntheticDatasets.reportTitle: How close {{dataset}} came to its profiles
syntheticDatasets.name: Dataset name
syntheticDatasets.scaleHelp: A multiple or a fraction of the profiled row counts, e.g. 10 or 0.5.
syntheticDatasets.noRuns: No table of this environment has a succeeded profile run in {{env}}.
syntheticDatasets.conditionsHelp: Give a relationship's children by a condition on the parent row. The first condition a parent meets decides its number of children; a parent meeting none takes the relationship's measured fan-out.
syntheticDatasets.assertionsHelp: Statements over the generated tables, each returning true or false. Each runs after generation and its result is reported; none changes the generated data.
syntheticDatasets.privateHelp: Noise every statistic generation draws from the tables under a privacy budget ε; a smaller ε adds more noise. Small tables need a larger ε. A number or date column whose synthetic rule declares its distribution needs no measured bounds and spends none of ε on them.
